title: Player state
description: Captures information about a player's current state including position, rotation, inventory, and game mode. Used in automated testing to verify player conditions or to set up test scenarios with specific player configurations.

action_set_vector3.title: Vector3
action_set_vector3.description: A 3D coordinate (x, y, z) representing a position or direction in the Minecraft world. Y is the vertical axis (up/down), while X and Z form the horizontal plane. Used for specifying locations, offsets, and movement directions.

action_set_block_volume.title: Block volume
action_set_block_volume.description: Defines a 3D volume of blocks in the world using a layered ASCII-art style format. Each character in the pattern maps to a block type through a key lookup, enabling efficient representation of structures like buildings, obstacles, or test arenas.

action_set_entity.title: Entity
action_set_entity.description: References an entity by type identifier for use in action sets. This allows actions to target specific entity types like 'minecraft:zombie' or custom entities from behavior packs when spawning, killing, or manipulating entities.
